english: The following continuous frequency distribution, in which $k$ is a positive integer, has arithmetic mean $32.5$ (computed with the class marks).
Let $D$ be the mean deviation about the mean and $\sigma$ the standard deviation of this distribution. Then the value of $\dfrac{D}{\sigma}$ is ______.
hindi: निम्न सतत बारंबारता बंटन, जिसमें $k$ एक धनात्मक पूर्णांक है, का समान्तर माध्य (वर्ग चिह्नों से परिकलित) $32.5$ है।
माना $D$ इस बंटन का माध्य के सापेक्ष माध्य विचलन है तथा $\sigma$ इसका मानक विचलन है। तब $\dfrac{D}{\sigma}$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: $\dfrac D\sigma=\dfrac{10.625}{12.5}=0.85$, less than $1$ as it must be.
originality_note: New: the ratio of the mean deviation to the standard deviation of one grouped distribution, with the table chosen so that both are exact and the missing frequency comes from the mean (way 5: two dispersion measures of one table). Closest known: computing MD and SD of a table separately. Different because: the table must be completed first and the answer is the ratio, which is always at most 1.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Changed: No change.
key_step: Completing the table from the mean, then two dispersion measures computed exactly.
justification: A three-stage numerical chain (missing frequency, MD, SD) with exact arithmetic and no options. Above the L2 table anchor 2025-P1-Q14 by one stage; Level 3.
